capabilities: Display the first heading of a note as its file explorer label
Fall back to the file name for notes without a heading
Restore original file names when the plugin is disabled
disambiguation: Not a heading outline or navigation pane; it only changes how file explorer entries are labelled.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author wanted to keep stable file names while still reading the sidebar at a glance, as in Zettlr's default behavior.
problem: When files are named by timestamp or ID, the file explorer labels convey nothing about note contents, and renaming files to fix this breaks stable names.

relations.evidence: Zettlr behaves this way by default; this brings the same reading comfort to Obsidian.

summary: File explorer relabeler that shows a note's first heading instead of its file name, without renaming files on disk.
